encryption_roundtrip.path: POST /documents → R2 encrypted → GET /documents/:id/content → server-side decrypt → plaintext stream

blocking_issues.title: ocr_job UNIQUE constraint missing
blocking_issues.description: ocr_job table does not have UNIQUE constraint on document_id. The ON CONFLICT (document_id) upsert logic in document-processing.ts will fail with 'there is no unique or exclusion constraint matching the ON CONFLICT specification'.
blocking_issues.fix: ALTER TABLE ocr_job ADD CONSTRAINT ocr_job_unique_document UNIQUE (document_id);

non_blocking_issues.title: Debug logging in mock mode
non_blocking_issues.description: console.log statements with [R2 mock] and [document-processing mock] prefixes will pollute logs in development and production (if mock mode is used). Remove or gate behind DEBUG env var.
non_blocking_issues.suggestion: Remove before production or guard: if (process.env.DEBUG === '1') console.log(...)

non_blocking_issues.title: Download authentication via query parameter
non_blocking_issues.description: Direct <a href> cannot pass x-firm-slug header. Fallback uses ?_firm=firmSlug query parameter. This is fragile and may be bypassed.
non_blocking_issues.suggestion: Investigate cookie-based auth or presigned URL mechanism in Phase 1.5+

non_blocking_issues.title: Versions endpoint exposes r2_key
non_blocking_issues.description: GET /documents/:id/versions returns DocumentVersion[] which includes r2_key. This is an internal implementation detail and should not be exposed to clients.
non_blocking_issues.suggestion: Strip r2_key from versions response in Phase 1.5+ (spec review)

non_blocking_issues.title: OCR pipeline runs on ciphertext
non_blocking_issues.description: pdf-parse is attempted on encrypted bytes and fails gracefully. Phase 1 design scoped as 'decrypt is out of scope'. Acceptable per spec, but Phase 2 should implement decrypt-first.
non_blocking_issues.suggestion: Phase 2 enhancement: decrypt ciphertext before OCR extraction
